title: Need testers for lunar parkour paintball game's base controls
author: alcanthro
selftext: Sadly I'm not very good at FPS types, or really most games that require a lot of coordination, so I can't really... test whether the controls are halfway decent or if the foundation game play feel works.  Unfortunately right now it's just one scene and the only build I have that runs alright is a Linux build and it's super rough around the edges so I don't want to just release it publicly. So I figured this would be a good place to see if anyone might be willing to give it a look.

comments.author: X_relevated
comments.body: If you can get it on the web or android I'd like to try it 🔥. Is  the Linux build available?

replies.author: alcanthro
replies.body: The Linux build is available but I don't want to post the link publicly yet because it's such an early draft. And I HOPE I will have a web build in a week. Technically I have one but it's more glitchy and it needs specific browser settings.

comments.author: FlimsyReality4086
comments.body: Linux only is not possible for me to test. But maybe in the future :) as for the perspective it really depends whats in your mind what you want the player to feel when playing your game. Is it more like PUBG or CS for example?

replies.author: alcanthro
replies.body: Right now it's really just a physics and control test. It could go in either direction, or... both.  I plan on releasing a number of lunar physics based games.
